suggestions.title: The Sound of Music
suggestions.description: A spirited governess brings music and joy back to a widowed naval captain's family in pre-WWII Austria. Robert Wise's timeless musical masterpiece brims with beloved songs like "My Favorite Things" and "Do-Re-Mi," and Julie Andrews is radiant as Maria. A heartwarming classic that has charmed generations — and the hills are definitely alive.

suggestions.title: The Imitation Game
suggestions.description: Mathematician Alan Turing leads a top-secret team to crack the German Enigma code during WWII — later facing persecution for his sexuality. Benedict Cumberbatch delivers a gripping, Oscar-nominated performance in this taut and emotionally powerful biopic about the father of modern computing, whose genius helped end a war and paid a tragic personal price.

suggestions.title: My Octopus Teacher
suggestions.description: A filmmaker forges an extraordinary bond with a wild octopus living in a South African kelp forest. This Oscar-winning documentary is a breathtaking, deeply moving portrait of nature, curiosity, and connection — a reminder of the wonder hidden just beneath the ocean's surface, and the unexpected friendship that changed one man's life.
